summary: Petrobras, a Brazilian oil & gas company, filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors approved adherence to a new economic subvention for diesel oil under Brazilian Provisional Measure MP 1,363, granting R$1.12 per liter for road-use diesel. The subvention is optional and aims to stabilize prices/supply during a Middle East conflict. Adherence requires discontinuation of prior subvention qualification processes (MPs 1,340/1,349). This is a routine government program participation announcement with no merger, acquisition, or corporate restructuring. No special situation exists.
